name: qjs_get_array_buffer_composition

ownership.argument: No class-gated getter exists on this build either, so the module composes it from the measured layout: accept the value only when the tag is -1 and the class id word at object+6 equals 19, then return the payload pointer at object+0x54 and write the byte length from object+0x58 into *pbyte_length.

provenance.source: Layout measured on a live runtime: the ArrayBuffer(512) object at 0x3C3146A0 has refcount 2, class id 19 at +6, the 0xA7 payload pointer 0x3C3A1B28 at +0x54 and the byte length 512 at +0x58; the ArrayBuffer(8) object at 0x3C314640 shows the same two offsets with 8. Thirteen functions reading +0x54/+0x58 were examined and none is class-gated, i.e. this build inlines the field reads after JS_GetOpaque rather than exporting a getter.

notes: No class-gated getter exists on this build either, so the module composes it from the measured layout: accept the value only when the tag is -1 and the class id word at object+6 equals 19, then return the payload pointer at object+0x54 and write the byte length from object+0x58 into *pbyte_length.
